description: KPI Performance Card is a powerful and interactive KPI visualization tool developed for Power BI users. It accelerates your decision-making processes by effectively presenting performance metrics in business intelligence and data analysis processes. Key Features: ✅ Real-Time KPI Tracking – View your measurement values compared to targets and instantly see your performance status. 🎯 Target Comparison – Clearly see your progress by comparing achievement rates with target values. 📊 Animated Progress Bar – Provides visual richness with an impressive animated progress bar to show performance ratio. 🎨 Fully Customizable Appearance – Create designs matching your reports with 15+ background themes, 10+ bar themes, and numerous color options. 🔔 Context Menu Support – Access additional information quickly with right-click functionality and deepen your data analysis. ⚙️ Advanced Parameter Settings – Customize all text fields such as title, currency, target text according to your language and needs. 🌟 Icon Library – Enrich your visuals with 30+ special icons available for both title and target areas. 📱 Responsive Design – Offers a modern user experience that adapts to every screen size and device. 🔗 Full Integration with Power BI – Works seamlessly in your reports, taking advantage of all Power BI features.
